name: Introduction and overview — Akizuki-class Destroyer — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Akizuki-class Destroyer
description: Introduction and overview of the Akizuki-class Destroyer: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. Japan's Akizuki class — four ships commissioned from 2012 — are general-purpose escort destroyers built around advanced anti-air warfare with the FCS-3A radar. They escort Japan's helicopter destroyers and protect sea lanes. A follow-on Asahi class refined the design. Baseline facts: Japanese escort destroyer; 4 built; advanced AAW radar; sea-lane protection..
